findings: Name matching includes infrastructure false positives; triage must require a positive reference and direct air releases before scientific review.
Native gas-turbine service callers include gas supply/pipeline/liquefaction, so turbine technology alone does not establish a power-generation GAINS role.

Extraction-site diesel and sweet-gas combustion documentation explicitly excludes NOx, SO2 and CH4 emissions and requires those to be assessed separately. Inspect both burner and extraction caller direct emissions before selecting factors; do not invent missing emissions or double scale.

Average building-machine diesel documents Swiss non-road 2015 machinery, excluding hydraulic diggers, pumps and mobile generators. Existing transport or residential aliases do not establish its native GAINS sector.
Owned prepared CLIC/supplement callers need separate review; native evidence does not authorize rewriting them.

Actual-coordinate check confirms both extraction burners have no NOx, SO2 or fossil-methane coordinates. All200native callers of each have direct air NOx and SO2, but no exact fossil-methane label. Other methane species/compartments and caller emission causes still require review; absence of this exact label is not proof of zero methane.
next: Review GAINS non-road sector boundary and caller-specific gas supply/distribution roles, then inspect extraction direct-emission ownership. Preserve all inventories pending explicit decisions.
